resources.string: Unreadable input settings were preserved in a recovery copy. You can continue editing the restored profiles.
Send controller input to Steam Input or the game.
This element sends no controller, mouse or keyboard input.
%1$s · Used by %2$d profiles. Changes apply to every profile using these bindings.
Add elements to the layout before assigning their actions.
Drag to move. Drag a corner to resize. Tap Properties to assign an action.
The selected display is not available. Connect it to edit this layout at its actual size.
This layout is used by %1$d profiles. Saved changes apply to all of them.
Buttons, sticks, triggers and extra keys
Reset the actions in %1$s to its base profile defaults? Layouts and other profiles will stay unchanged.
Delete %1$s? Modes using it will return to their built-in default profile. Saved layouts and shared settings will remain available.
Applies to all profiles. Auto shows the main-screen controls when no gamepad is connected in Game mode.
Choose a layout or create your own
Choose Profile controls in the second-screen session menu. The Profile and Second screen selectors in the Controller menu choose the controls to show.
Shared with %1$s. Edits apply to those profiles too.
Copy from another profile or keep settings shared
Keep the current setup and stop sharing changes
Layouts store elements and their positions. Each profile can assign its own actions. Edit at full size on the target screen.
Delete the unused layout %1$s and its saved actions?
Reuse %1$s from another profile. The other control sources will stay unchanged.
By default, all controls and custom layouts are independent copies. Sharing only links the physical controls.
Use these elements and positions. Sharing keeps future geometry edits in sync; your button actions remain independent. A different layout starts with unassigned actions.
Copy these controls and actions, or link them so future edits apply to both profiles.
Hide stick when not in use
When assigned to the mouse pointer: tap to click, hold to drag, and scroll with two fingers.
%1$s has a quick-menu override. Select Auto there to use its default profile and all three saved parts.

Held while the stick is moved in any direction: press above 55%, release below 35%. Use Direction keys to assign each direction separately. DroidDeck commands run once per deflection. The stick click is configured separately.
Held while touching the trackpad; released when you lift your finger. DroidDeck commands run once per touch. The trackpad click is configured separately.
Held when the trigger passes 55%; released below 35%. DroidDeck commands run once per press.
Enable recording, use controls in a running session, then return and read the results. Measures DroidDeck dispatch time only, not display latency. Recording ends when the app process closes.
Back · twice in Steam, once in Desktop
In Steam mode. Holding Back also opens quick access.
Your panel choice is remembered. Desktop opens a second workspace; it does not switch the session or its input profile.
The controller type seen by Steam or the game.
How touches on the game screen are handled. Profile buttons keep their assigned actions.
Show a pointer for direct touches on the game screen.
Mouse action when holding a finger on the game screen.
First action: single tap. Second action: double tap.
Tap to hold, tap again to release. Opening a menu or switching profiles releases the button.
Assign a key to each diagonal. An empty diagonal presses its two neighboring directions.
Your old screen keys are saved as imported profiles below. Select one to use or edit it. Your current profile selections have been kept.
The old screen keys could not be imported automatically. The original settings have been kept.
